message.text:
I will identify distinct enforcement sites rather than listing every duplicate helper. Each site will be paired with its file path.

Twelve distinct enforcement sites were identified across the codebase. These include API read access, list filters, HTTP file permissions, RSS feeds, frontend sitemaps, SSE events, attachment metadata, reaction services, user notifications, stats, and outbound email.

Two additional enforcement sites were found: mention notification targeting and comment creation privacy checks. The final list groups these by distinct code locations rather than individual API methods.

The twelve enforcement sites are now listed with exact file paths. They span memo reads, list filters, file permissions, RSS, sitemap, SSE, attachment metadata, reactions, inbox notifications, stats, email dispatch, and mention helpers.

h15.
API memo read (`checkMemoReadAccess`) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go  
API memo list (VisibilityList / creator filters) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go  
API attachments — server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go, server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go  
API reactions — server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go  
API comments — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go  
API inbox notifications (`canViewerAccessMemo`) — server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go  
API user stats — server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go  
HTTP file server (`checkAttachmentPermission`) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go  
RSS (public-only `VisibilityList`) — server/router/rss/rss.go  
Frontend sitemap (public-only) — server/router/frontend/frontend.go  
SSE delivery (`SSEClient.canReceive`) — server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go  
Notification email (`canViewerAccessMemo`) — server/notification/email.go  
Mention notification targeting — server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go  

These independently decide who may see a memo (or its attachments/events). Share links (`memo_share_service.go` / fileserver share tokens) bypass normal visibility for a specific memo; they are an exception path, not a general visibility check.
